articles.title: Nvidia's answer to rogue AI changes the conversation
articles.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang just made two huge moves that might change how we think about AI risk entirely. First, a new agent safety platform engineered to catch and quarantine rogue AI agents in milliseconds, then a record-shattering $235 billion stock buyback that speaks volumes about how confident Nvidia is in where this is all headed. In The Loop host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down how this new two-part safety system actually works, why Huang's stance is the opposite of what other AI labs are saying, and what a recent state dinner guest list reveals about who's really steering the US-China AI race.
